Sydney Scholars India Scholarship Program 2025-26 is an opportunity provided by the University of Sydney for students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate courses at the university. This program aims to enhance engagement between the University and India by investing in research, collaborating with industry partners, and deepening educational commitments for student success. Selected candidates will receive scholarships worth $5,00,000.
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
be an Indian citizen currently residing in the country
have applied for an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree at the University of Sydney at the time of application
have received an unconditional offer letter for their coursework, but have not started the course yet
Students who received this scholarship before are ineligible to apply.
A total of 28 annual scholarships are available in the following manner:-
Two 100% tuition fee scholarships for any undergraduate degree up to four years of full-time study.
Ten $20,000 first-year scholarships for undergraduate and postgraduate students.
Sixteen $10,000 first-year scholarships for undergraduate and postgraduate students.
Proof of Indian residency such as a passport
Documents related to previous academic results including marksheets, certificates, etc.

Candidates will be selected based on academic merit, personal statements, and their applications.
The scholarship will be terminated if the recipient:
withdraws from an eligible course or fails to enroll,
begins part-time study without prior approval,
does not maintain satisfactory academic performance,
is found guilty of serious misconduct, including providing false information in their application,
accepts another scholarship valued over AUD 10,000 per annum,
does not resume study after approved leave.
If serious misconduct is found or the Scholarship is terminated, the University may require reimbursement of any funds paid.
Question: Who is offering this opportunity?
The University of Sydney is offering this opportunity.
Question: Is accommodation provided under this opportunity?
No such facilities are available under this scholarship scheme.
Question: Can students apply for the scholarship before applying for a course at the university?
No, applicants can only apply after receiving an unconditional offer letter.
This scholarship is transferable to another major, degree or faculty. However, the scholarship cannot be transferred to another university.
Question: What is the mode of application?
The mode of application is online through the official university website.
